name: U06 - Graph Mapper: Maps a number of values using a function
brief: Teaching: Graph Mapper: Maps a number of values using a function.
context:
4- Graph Mapper: Maps a number of values using a function.

In case we had a domain of values beyond the domain of the graph mapper, we can remap the INPUT values to match a standard (0.0 to 1.0) domain of the graph, use the graph, then remap the OUTPUT values back to the original domain.
